theory: The application layer translates terminal inputs into configured workflow operations and owns concrete resources. Project switching preserves the pinned root environment while rebuilding problem-local state.
instead_of: Constructing everything inside command handlers would conflate presentation, project identity, and kernel lifetime.

absorption.rationale: A local command is an extension; authenticated concurrent clients require another ownership model.

world_mapping.rationale: Root environment and active problem are explicit and different concepts.

abstraction.rationale: Factories are explicit, but rich terminal, plain terminal and CLI maintain separate interaction adapters.

justification.rationale: The opener explains why it takes live configuration rather than retaining launch-time configuration.

honest_limits.rationale: Setup refusal is explicit, but construction still relies on host executable and console semantics.

rehearsals.requirement: Add a slash command for an existing session operation
rehearsals.why: Classify it once and connect a terminal adapter.

rehearsals.requirement: Serve multiple authenticated web users concurrently
rehearsals.why: The opener owns one active local session and carries no tenant identity.

rehearsals.requirement: Change the model before switching problems
rehearsals.why: The current configuration is an argument at the handoff.
